mechanism: Both agents have beta-blocking and antiarrhythmic properties that may be additive, potentially causing excessive bradycardia, AV block, or hypotension; amiodarone also inhibits CYP3A4 which may increase timolol levels if systemically absorbed.
action: Monitor heart rate and blood pressure regularly; assess for signs of bradycardia or heart block; use lowest effective timolol dose and ensure proper instillation technique to minimize systemic absorption.
